summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Big S Media Production MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests PASS covering services, portfolio (list/detail/404), quote & appointment creation, admin login (valid/invalid), auth-protected endpoints (401 without token), status updates for quotes/appointments, project create + soft-delete + public list exclusion. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home loads with hero + CTAs, 'Demander un devis' navigates to Devis tab and full quote submission reaches 'Merci !' success screen, admin key icon opens login and valid credentials load the dashboard (stats 3 demandes / 1 RDV / 4 projets visible), the 3 tabs (Demandes/RDV/Projets) switch correctly, add-project form opens with all fields, status pill toggled Nouveau -> En cours successfully. No red screens, no runtime errors. Only minor RN-web console warnings (useNativeDriver JS fallback, props.pointerEvents deprecation) which do not affect functionality. Success rate: backend 100%, frontend 100% on flows exercised.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported...' — Native animated module not linked on web preview; harmless fallback but appears repeatedly. Consider removing useNativeDriver from any Animated.timing/spring on web or gating by Platform.OS. Reference: likely third-party (react-navigation) — cosmetic.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely originating from a dependency; monitor but not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _id is excluded consistently via dict comprehension in every response — good.
server.py: Soft-delete correctly filters public GET /portfolio and GET /portfolio/{id} via deleted_at existence check.
server.py: Admin auth uses JWT + DB check on admins collection — solid; unauthorized paths return 401 as required.
api.ts: Uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix — compliant with env rules.
All interactive components carry testID matching the spec (hero-quote-button, admin-access-button, login-*, admin-tab-*, quote-status-*, delete-project-*, etc.) — testable.
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed quotes/appointments created via API during pytest run (TEST_*). Soft-deleted project created and removed as part of the create+delete test.
